rule.text: kill if > 100 candidates at depth <= 4 on more than half the tasks, or coverage < 80% (ATTACK-20261014 §3 M4); unchanged from M4
rule.layer: precise interfaces + temporal constraints, existential reading

claims.claim: x enters unchecked: no schema is applied to it before the first stage
a call stage hands v to a child; the child contract types it (CALL_TYPE), not P01
a judge stage reads only the previous value
a step stage is a fn:pure of v alone (slot params ["v"]): any value in, any value out
every stage output is checked against that stage's out, a required schema slot
the output is the last stage's value, so it satisfies STAGES[-1].out: a declared type fixed at S6
ITEMS is a path accessor (assemble.mjs renderPath): a location in the task inputs or in x
the location holds a list (flow.map at line 7 iterates it)
each item is dereferenced, so a null or undefined item throws: items are non-null
the id echo dereferences each item again
the output is REDUCE(results), returned unchecked; REDUCE sees only [{...BODY(item), id}]
tries counts up from 0: an integer
GEN reads {input: x, problem}: any x
VERIFY reads (out, x); its truthy return is the problem, unchecked

claims.has: return problem ? { result: null, review: { problem, tries } } : { result: out, tries };
claims.claim: two closed shapes: {result, tries} or {result: null, review: {problem, tries}}

claims.has: callModel({ model, system: String(system), prompt: text, schema,
claims.claim: result is a GEN judge value, requested under GEN.schema (a slot): declared, fixed at S6
the input is read only through PARTS, a fn:pure over (task, x): any value
what is checked is each part input against ARG, not x
READS checks child outputs as COMBINE reads them, not the fragment output
the output is COMBINE(kids, parts), returned unchecked; no slot declares its schema
